records.title: Danish for Professionals
records.text: DANISH 411 Danish for Professionals (3) A&H Combines intensive beginning Danish language for professionals with a substantive introduction to Danish culture and society. This course is geared to upper-division undergraduates and graduate students preparing to hold internships in professional offices in Denmark or study at Danish universities via UW study Abroad. Does not meet foreign language requirement. Offered: Sp.
